bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All eight authored EURAU contract rows remain issuer-native issuance lanes, not bridge representations. The live customer-facing cross-chain path is AllUnity’s documented mapping bridge (issuer burns source EURAU and mints destination EURAU to a registered wallet). The Oct 2025 Chainlink CCIP/CCT partnership is still announced, not registered: TokenAdminRegistry 1.5.0 getPool(EURAU)=0 on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, and Tempo as of 2026-08-18, and no pool holds MINTER_ROLE/BURNER_ROLE. Do not treat destination supply as a lock/mint representation of a single canonical chain.

controls.label: AllUnity issuer-backend same-currency mapping bridge

routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: AllUnity’s product docs describe a same-currency cross-chain bridge that burns on the source chain and mints to the holder’s registered wallet on the target chain. Conservation is operational (issuer mapping), not a single canonical lock/escrow. Destination lanes remain native-issuance.
routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: No lockbox. Official CCIP TokenAdminRegistry 1.5.0 has no EURAU pool on the seven EVM/Tempo registries checked 2026-08-18, so this path is not a registered CCT lock or burn-mint pool.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: No on-chain peer/allowlist. Transfers require an AllUnity “bridge mapping” to a registered wallet.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No public on-chain CCIP or adapter rate-limit admin. Any ceiling is issuer-operational and unpublished.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Execution uses the already-reviewed native issuance surface (EVM MINTER_ROLE / BURNER_ROLE EOAs and the Solana Token-2022 authority). Those identities stay in Mint Authority and are not restated here as bridge controllers.

controls.capDescription: The mapping bridge can mint destination EURAU only as the counterpart of a source burn, subject to AllUnity’s backend. It is not independent native issuance and it is not a registered CCIP token pool.

sources.label: AllUnity product docs: issuance, redemption, and cross-chain bridging

controls.evidence: AllUnity’s current product documentation (fetched 2026-08-18) states: “Transfer tokens from one blockchain to another in the same currency. AllUnity burns on the source chain and mints to your registered wallet on the target chain.” That is issuer-backend burn-and-mint over the existing native lanes. It is a distinct capability from the native mint already recorded under Mint Authority. Official CCIP registries still have no EURAU pool, so this control must not be labelled as Chainlink CCIP and must not reuse the native EOA minter/admin addresses as controllerAddress.
